prompt: In the town where the most successful American Ace of World War 2 to survive that war was born, there is a college. What was the name and percentage of the largest demographic of full and part time students attending that college in 2020?
answer: The ace was **David McCampbell**, who was born in **Bessemer, Alabama**. The college there is **Lawson State Community College**. In 2020, its largest student demographic was **Black or African American students, at approximately 80% of full- and part-time students**.
